name: BPC-157
summary: A synthetic peptide derived from a protein found in gastric juice, studied for tissue repair, tendon and ligament healing, and gut health in preclinical models.

name: TB-500
summary: A synthetic version of a naturally occurring peptide investigated for cell migration, angiogenesis, and recovery of muscle and connective tissue in animal studies.

name: GHK-Cu
summary: A naturally occurring copper-binding tripeptide widely used in cosmetic research for collagen synthesis, skin remodeling, and antioxidant activity.

name: Ipamorelin
summary: A selective growth-hormone secretagogue (GHRP) studied for stimulating GH release with minimal effect on cortisol or appetite in preclinical work.

name: CJC-1295
summary: A growth-hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH) analog researched for sustained increases in GH and IGF-1 levels, often studied alongside Ipamorelin.

name: Sermorelin
summary: A 29-amino-acid GHRH fragment investigated as a research tool for assessing pituitary growth-hormone reserve and GH stimulation.

name: Tesamorelin
summary: A stabilized GHRH analog studied clinically for reduction of visceral adipose tissue and metabolic outcomes.

name: Semaglutide
summary: A long-acting glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist extensively researched for glucose regulation, appetite, and body-weight outcomes.

name: Tirzepatide
summary: A dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist studied for combined effects on glucose control and weight regulation.

name: PT-141
summary: A melanocortin receptor agonist researched for its effects on sexual arousal pathways via the central nervous system.

name: Melanotan II
summary: A synthetic melanocortin analog studied in research settings for pigmentation pathways and related signaling.

name: Epitalon
summary: A synthetic tetrapeptide investigated in animal and cell models for telomerase activity and circadian/pineal regulation.

name: Thymosin Alpha-1
summary: A peptide derived from the thymus studied for immune modulation and T-cell function in clinical and preclinical research.

name: MOTS-c
summary: A mitochondrial-derived peptide researched for roles in metabolic regulation, insulin sensitivity, and exercise physiology.

name: Selank
summary: A synthetic analog of the peptide tuftsin studied in animal models for anxiolytic and cognitive-modulating properties.

name: Semax
summary: A synthetic peptide derived from ACTH studied for neuroprotective and cognitive effects in research settings, particularly in Russia.

name: AOD-9604
summary: A fragment of human growth hormone investigated for lipolytic (fat-metabolism) activity without the growth effects of full GH.

name: GHRP-6
summary: An early growth-hormone secretagogue researched for GH release; notable for also stimulating appetite via ghrelin pathways.
